sdkPath.title: Dart SDK path
sdkPath.description: Optional path to a Dart SDK directory or `dart` executable. Leave empty to use FVM or PATH.

useFvm.title: Use FVM when .fvm exists
useFvm.description: Automatically invoke `fvm dart` when a `.fvm` directory is detected in the project root.

pubOffline.title: Pass --offline to pub commands
pubOffline.description: Use cached packages without touching pub.dev when running pub get or pub upgrade.
